<?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
// Keepsoft demo seed - PrintPilot. A Melbourne cafe: menu, 4 printers, routing rules, 8 orders and a realistic print log.
global $wpdb; add_filter('pre_wp_mail','__return_true');
// Do not let the live router print while we build demo orders; we write the log ourselves below.
remove_action('woocommerce_order_status_changed',['PrintPilot_Router','on_status_changed'],20);
update_option('woocommerce_calc_taxes','yes'); update_option('woocommerce_prices_include_tax','yes');
$wpdb->query("DELETE FROM {$wpdb->prefix}woocommerce_tax_rates");
WC_Tax::_insert_tax_rate(['tax_rate_country'=>'AU','tax_rate'=>'10.0000','tax_rate_name'=>'GST','tax_rate_priority'=>1,'tax_rate_compound'=>0,'tax_rate_shipping'=>1,'tax_rate_order'=>1,'tax_rate_class'=>'']);
$cats=[]; foreach(['Coffee','Brunch','Mains','Sides & sweets'] as $c){ $t=wp_insert_term($c,'product_cat'); $cats[$c]=is_wp_error($t)?get_term_by('name',$c,'product_cat')->term_id:$t['term_id']; }
$menu=[['Flat White',5.2,'Coffee'],['Long Black',4.8,'Coffee'],['Iced Latte',6.5,'Coffee'],['Smashed Avo on Sourdough',21,'Brunch'],['Bacon & Egg Roll',12.5,'Brunch'],['Chicken Parmigiana',26,'Mains'],['Fish & Chips',24,'Mains'],['Banana Bread',7.5,'Sides & sweets'],['Lemon Tart',8.5,'Sides & sweets']];
$P=[]; foreach($menu as $i=>[$n,$pr,$c]){ $p=new WC_Product_Simple(); $p->set_name($n); $p->set_sku('CAFE-'.(10+$i)); $p->set_regular_price($pr); $p->set_status('publish'); $p->set_category_ids([$cats[$c]]); $p->save(); $P[$n]=wc_get_product($p->get_id()); }
// Printers
$d=PrintPilot_Settings::printer_defaults();
$printers=[
 'pstation'=>array_merge($d,['id'=>'pstation','name'=>'Front counter (browser print)','method'=>'station_html','paper'=>'80']),
 'pkitchen'=>array_merge($d,['id'=>'pkitchen','name'=>'Kitchen - Epson TM-T88VI (LAN)','method'=>'network','ip'=>'192.168.1.50','port'=>9100,'paper'=>'80','cut'=>'full','copies'=>1,'fallback_email'=>'kitchen@harbourcafe.com.au']),
 'pbar'=>array_merge($d,['id'=>'pbar','name'=>'Barista - Star TSP143 (USB)','method'=>'station_escpos','connection'=>'usb','paper'=>'58']),
 'pemail'=>array_merge($d,['id'=>'pemail','name'=>'Owner copy (email)','method'=>'email','email'=>'owner@harbourcafe.com.au','paper'=>'a4']),
];
update_option(PrintPilot_Settings::OPT_PRINTERS,$printers,false);
$s=PrintPilot_Settings::get(); $s['default_printer']='pstation'; $s['default_template']='tkitchen'; $s['station_name']='Front counter iPad'; update_option(PrintPilot_Settings::OPT_SETTINGS,$s);
update_option(PrintPilot_Settings::OPT_RULES,[
 ['id'=>'rkitchen','name'=>'Food orders - kitchen ticket','enabled'=>1,'statuses'=>['processing'],'categories'=>[$cats['Brunch'],$cats['Mains']],'shipping_methods'=>[],'payment_methods'=>[],'order_type'=>'any','meta_key'=>'','meta_value'=>'','printer'=>'pkitchen','template'=>'tkitchen','copies'=>1,'split_items'=>0,'stop'=>0],
 ['id'=>'rbar','name'=>'Coffee orders - barista ticket','enabled'=>1,'statuses'=>['processing'],'categories'=>[$cats['Coffee']],'shipping_methods'=>[],'payment_methods'=>[],'order_type'=>'any','meta_key'=>'','meta_value'=>'','printer'=>'pbar','template'=>'tkitchen','copies'=>1,'split_items'=>0,'stop'=>0],
 ['id'=>'rdelivery','name'=>'Delivery orders - packing slip at the counter','enabled'=>1,'statuses'=>['processing'],'categories'=>[],'shipping_methods'=>[],'payment_methods'=>[],'order_type'=>'delivery','meta_key'=>'','meta_value'=>'','printer'=>'pstation','template'=>'tpacking','copies'=>1,'split_items'=>0,'stop'=>0],
 ['id'=>'rreceipt','name'=>'Completed orders - receipt','enabled'=>1,'statuses'=>['completed'],'categories'=>[],'shipping_methods'=>[],'payment_methods'=>[],'order_type'=>'any','meta_key'=>'','meta_value'=>'','printer'=>'pstation','template'=>'treceipt','copies'=>1,'split_items'=>0,'stop'=>0],
],false);
// Orders
$custs=[['Hannah','Doyle','0412 334 901','pickup',''],['Wei','Zhang','0421 778 036','pickup','Oat milk please'],['Sam','Pettigrew','0409 551 482','delivery','Gate code 4471, leave at door'],['Aisha','Rahman','0433 612 077','pickup',''],['Callum','Rees','0417 265 840','delivery',''],['Tess','Marino','0402 981 336','pickup','Extra hot'],['Nick','Papas','0438 417 202','pickup','No onion'],['Georgie','Lam','0425 190 663','delivery','Call on arrival']];
$baskets=[[['Flat White',2],['Banana Bread',1]],[['Iced Latte',1],['Bacon & Egg Roll',1]],[['Chicken Parmigiana',2],['Fish & Chips',1]],[['Long Black',1],['Smashed Avo on Sourdough',1]],[['Fish & Chips',2]],[['Flat White',1],['Lemon Tart',2]],[['Chicken Parmigiana',1],['Iced Latte',2]],[['Smashed Avo on Sourdough',2],['Flat White',2]]];
$orders=[];
foreach($custs as $i=>$c){ $o=wc_create_order(['status'=>'pending']); $ago=[2,9,16,31,47,64,88,130][$i];
 $addr=['first_name'=>$c[0],'last_name'=>$c[1],'email'=>strtolower($c[0].'.'.$c[1]).'@gmail.com','phone'=>$c[2],'country'=>'AU','state'=>'VIC','postcode'=>'3030','city'=>'Point Cook','address_1'=>mt_rand(3,90).' Boardwalk Boulevard'];
 $o->set_address($addr,'billing'); $o->set_address($addr,'shipping');
 foreach($baskets[$i] as [$n,$q]) $o->add_product($P[$n],$q);
 $sh=new WC_Order_Item_Shipping(); if($c[3]==='delivery'){ $sh->set_method_title('Delivery (local)'); $sh->set_method_id('flat_rate'); $sh->set_total(6); } else { $sh->set_method_title('Pickup in store'); $sh->set_method_id('local_pickup'); $sh->set_total(0); } $o->add_item($sh);
 $o->set_payment_method($i%3?'stripe':'cod'); $o->set_payment_method_title($i%3?'Credit card':'Pay in store'); if($c[4]) $o->set_customer_note($c[4]);
 $o->set_date_created(gmdate('Y-m-d H:i:s',time()-$ago*60)); $o->calculate_totals(true); $o->set_status($i<3?'processing':'completed'); $o->save(); $orders[]=$o; }
// Print log (written directly so nothing tries to reach a real printer)
$t=PrintPilot_Install::table(); $wpdb->query("DELETE FROM $t");
$rows=[ // order idx, printer, template, status, attempts, source, error, minutes ago
 [0,'pkitchen','tkitchen','printed',1,'auto:processing','',2],[0,'pbar','tkitchen','printed',1,'auto:processing','',2],
 [1,'pbar','tkitchen','printed',1,'auto:processing','',9],[1,'pkitchen','tkitchen','printed',1,'auto:processing','',9],
 [2,'pkitchen','tkitchen','pending',0,'auto:processing','',1],[2,'pstation','tpacking','pending',0,'auto:processing','',1],
 [3,'pstation','treceipt','printed',1,'auto:completed','',31],[3,'pkitchen','tkitchen','failed',3,'auto:processing','Could not connect to 192.168.1.50:9100 (timed out). Fallback email sent.',47],
 [4,'pstation','tpacking','printed',1,'auto:processing','',47],[5,'pbar','tkitchen','printed',1,'auto:processing','',64],
 [6,'pkitchen','tkitchen','printed',2,'auto:processing','',88],[6,'pemail','treceipt','printed',1,'auto:completed','',88],
 [7,'pstation','treceipt','printed',1,'reprint','',130],
 [0,'pstation','tkitchen','printed',1,'test','',300],
];
foreach($rows as $r){ $p=$printers[$r[1]]; $when=gmdate('Y-m-d H:i:s',time()-$r[7]*60);
 $wpdb->insert($t,['order_id'=>$r[5]==='test'?0:$orders[$r[0]]->get_id(),'printer_id'=>$r[1],'template_id'=>$r[2],'method'=>$p['method'],'status'=>$r[3],'copies'=>1,'attempts'=>$r[4],'source'=>$r[5],'station'=>in_array($r[3],['printed'])&&in_array($p['method'],['station_html','station_escpos'])?'Front counter iPad':'','error'=>$r[6]?:null,'meta'=>wp_json_encode([]),'created_gmt'=>$when,'updated_gmt'=>$when,'printed_gmt'=>$r[3]==='printed'?$when:null]); }
PrintPilot_Settings::touch_station('Front counter iPad',['ready'=>['pstation','pbar'],'printers'=>['pstation','pbar']]);
update_option('permalink_structure','/%postname%/'); flush_rewrite_rules();
